title: robots.txt blocks OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search index)
detail: Search/answer bots must be allowed to be recommended.
fix: Allow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt (e.g. 'User-agent: OAI-SearchBot' / 'Allow: /').

title: robots.txt blocks PerplexityBot (Perplexity index)
detail: Search/answer bots must be allowed to be recommended.
fix: Allow PerplexityBot in robots.txt (e.g. 'User-agent: PerplexityBot' / 'Allow: /').

title: GBP name does not match real-world signage
detail: Keyword-stuffed names can rank short-term but violate Google's guidelines and risk suspension.
fix: Use the exact legal/signage name.

title: Site is not served over HTTPS
fix: Install a certificate and redirect all HTTP URLs to HTTPS.

title: No page targets 4 of 4 core services
detail: Intent-matched pages are how a local business earns organic traffic and gives AI assistants something specific to cite.
evidence: heating engineer, boiler repair, boiler installation, emergency plumber
fix: Create one useful page per core service (own title, H1, price guidance, process, FAQs, local proof). Do not mass-produce near-duplicate area pages.

title: Fewer reviews than the median competitor
detail: Prominence signals include review count, rating, recency and response rate. Close the gap with a compliant ask-everyone process (no gating, no incentives).

title: 'Leeds' not in homepage title or H1
detail: Local relevance: make the service area explicit where users and crawlers look first.
fix: Work 'Leeds' and the primary service into the title and H1 naturally.

title: Homepage title is generic or a single word
detail: The title is the strongest on-page signal and the headline in search results.
fix: Use a unique title with the primary service, the place and the brand, e.g. 'Heating engineer in Leeds | Brand'.

title: No mobile viewport meta tag
fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

title: Gas work offered but no Gas Safe ID supplied
fix: Gas work must be done by a Gas Safe registered business: supply the ID.

title: Business hours not set
Services/products not listed on GBP
No tap-to-call (tel:) link with the primary number
detail: Mobile local searchers frequently call directly.
fix: Make the phone number a tel: link.

title: Business name not found in page text
fix: Use the exact business name consistently in header, footer and contact page.

title: No LocalBusiness-type structured data found
detail: Structured data is hygiene that helps machines confirm name, address, phone and hours. Controlled tests show no citation uplift by itself, so do not expect it to rank you.
fix: Add JSON-LD using the most specific type (HVACBusiness). Run `python -m local_seo_agent schema <client>` to generate it from your facts.

title: Homepage has no <h1>
No readable XML sitemap found
fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.

title: 'Gas Safe' claimed on the site but no registration ID supplied
detail: CAP 3.50: trust marks need authorisation. Verify on the public register; this tool cannot.
fix: Add the Gas Safe registration number to client.toml [client.regulator_ids] and show it on the page.

title: Company number not found on the crawled pages
detail: Limited companies must show their registered name, number, place of registration and registered office on the website (SI 2015/17). Image-only footers are not detected.
fix: Add a footer or legal page: registered name, company number, 'Registered in <nation>', registered office.

title: No privacy policy link found
detail: UK GDPR requires a privacy notice where personal data is collected (forms, calls, tracking).

title: Analytics/advertising tags observed and no cookie/consent wording found
detail: PECR (UK): non-essential tags (ads, remarketing, call tracking; GA4 in default configuration likely does not meet the statistical exemption) generally need prior opt-in. This crawl cannot tell whether tags fire before consent; observed only. [LAWYER] for consent design.

title: Homepage has no canonical link
fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing at the preferred URL.

title: Homepage has no meta description
fix: Write a unique, accurate description with city, services and a call to action.

title: No email address found on the site
detail: E-Commerce Regulations 2002 reg 6: an email address (not just a contact form) should be easily accessible.

title: Star rating shown without a link to the review source
detail: DMCC Act 2024: displayed ratings must come from all genuine reviews and name their source. Hard-coded or cherry-picked ratings are risky.
fix: Show the live rating from the named platform, with a link.

title: CDN/WAF bot blocking cannot be detected from outside
detail: Cloudflare blocks AI bots by default on domains created since 2025-07-01. A spoofed user-agent test is unreliable because WAFs verify bots by IP.
fix: Check Cloudflare 'AI Crawl Control' / WAF settings and server logs for real OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot hits.

title: Directory NAP consistency requires manual verification
detail: We do not scrape directories (ToS). See the manual checklist in the plan.

title: Core Web Vitals field data not collected in this run
detail: Run with --psi and a PageSpeed API key to read CrUX field data. Small sites often have no field data.

title: Companies House status not checked
detail: Set COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY (free) so the audit can confirm the company is active.

title: Very little text on the homepage
detail: Not a ranking rule, but a page needs enough substance to answer what the business does, where and for whom.
fix: Say what you do, where you work, who it is for, how to book and why to trust you, using real details.

title: GBP description empty
Few photos on GBP
Special/holiday hours not set
Verify on GBP: 24/7 hours accuracy
Verify on GBP: Gas Safe ID shown
Verify on GBP: Service areas set (max 20)
Many images lack alt text
'Registered in England and Wales / Scotland / Northern Ireland' not found
Training-only bots are blocked: GPTBot, ClaudeBot
detail: Owner's choice. Per vendor docs this does not affect search/answer inclusion.

title: Service-area business: street address checks skipped
detail: Hide the address on GBP; list up to 20 service areas. Do not publish a fake storefront address.

title: No lang attribute on <html>
Primary phone is a mobile (07) number
detail: A local geographic number may read as more local; keep one primary number everywhere.
